summary: Full regression pass for the multi-page restructure. Backend pytest 7/7 (expanded schema, honeypot, attachments). Frontend: all 9 routes render 200 with correct H1s, all critical data-testids present (nav, hero, home sections, about, contact, footer, quote form, quote confirmation). End-to-end quote flow verified: empty submit -> error toast (form retained), full submit -> POST /api/consultations 200 + quote-confirmation with 'Thank you for contacting ND Curtains'. Honeypot verified server-side (payload with company not stored). Refund policy contains 'Australian Consumer Law' + '50%'. WhatsApp FAB on all pages linking to wa.me/61487930023. Contact page phone/email/whatsapp/location links correct.

testid_mismatches.issue: Footer link testids are generated by slugifying full label, so testids do NOT match spec. Spec expected: footer-link-about, footer-link-refund-policy, footer-link-privacy, footer-link-terms. Actual: footer-link-about-us, footer-link-refund-cancellation-policy, footer-link-privacy-policy, footer-link-terms-conditions.
testid_mismatches.fix_hint: In Footer.jsx replace label-derived testids with explicit stable keys, e.g. { label: 'About Us', to: '/about', tid: 'about' } and use `footer-link-${l.tid}`.

action_items: LOW: Align footer link data-testids with review-request spec (footer-link-about, footer-link-refund-policy, footer-link-privacy, footer-link-terms) by using explicit tid keys instead of slugified labels. Everything else works.
critical_code_review_comments: GetAQuote posts to `${API}/consultations` correctly using dev/prod API-base pattern; consistent with previous refactor.
Honeypot handled both client-side (silent return) and server-side (returns 200 without persistence) — good defence-in-depth.
Rate limiter is in-memory only; will not survive restarts/multi-worker. Acceptable for MVP but note for production.
send_notification_email is async but swallows exceptions (log only) — intentional non-blocking; consider observability hook.
React-three/drei still emits WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' warnings and Three.Clock deprecation notices — harmless but noisy.
POST /api/consultations returns 200 not 201; not blocking but non-idiomatic.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_* consultations created via pytest and one UI submission (TEST_UI_Playwright). No cleanup endpoint.
